name: should delete a comment from an article

steps.name: Fill "This is a test comment." getByPlaceholder('Write a comment...')
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.card').filter({ hasText: 'This is a test comment.' })
Delete comment: This is a test comment.
Click locator('.card').filter({ hasText: 'This is a test comment.' }).locator('i.ion-trash-a')
Expect "not toBeVisible" locator('.card').filter({ hasText: 'This is a test comment.' })
